official_sources.finding: The Basic RTC_GAMMA request schema admits one Sentinel-1 IW GRDH granule with the S1[ABCD] prefix and declares validate_only on POST /jobs. This includes the proposed S1D prefix syntactically, but does not verify that the four exact scenes are processable by the service.
ASF documents single RTC_GAMMA job definitions, authenticated GET /user, POST /jobs, and GET /jobs.
ASF lists 60 Basic credits for a 10 m RTC job; four exact candidate jobs have a 240-credit nominal ceiling. The actual account balance and accepted costs remain unobserved.
ASF describes full-scene GAMMA RTC as UTM GeoTIFF and says ordinary On Demand products are available for 14 days. Generated product identity, files, georeferencing, and pixels remain unobserved.

ASF asks for the acknowledgement supplied with each product when products are used in a publication or presentation. This guidance does not itself prove permission to redistribute source or derived pixels.
The official Copernicus Data Space terms identify the free, full, open Sentinel data legal notice. This is input-data context, not an independent determination of HyP3 generated-product rights.

next_dependency: One owner-controlled account capacity result, then exact-scene validate-only and product-rights gates under the existing approved envelope. No paid credits, automatic retry, derived-pixel publication, baseline, change analysis, attribution, or scientific claim.
